not_claimed: a proved weighted norm for Z_S-Z_C
a screened-exterior DtN existence or invertibility theorem
a numerical inverse norm for the PHYS55 hybrid operator
driven xi=Fy-phi, sigma(E), or Maxwellian k_HH(T)

operator_construction.axisymmetry: The displaced z-axis potential preserves m, with the usual real-potential conjugation relation between m and -m; no angular coupling is discarded.
operator_construction.dtn_identity: Z_S-Z_C=(P_C^-)^* V (I-R_C^+ V)^(-1) P_C^+; (P_C^-)^* is the unweighted-volume-pairing dual transpose H_{+a}->X*
operator_construction.full_matching: The physical r=27 match needs the full P+Q boundary operator; a Q-only collar does not prove it. If M_PP is invertible, use M_QQ-M_QP M_PP^(-1)M_PQ.
operator_construction.pq_feshbach: Veff_Q=V_QQ+V_QP(I-R_P V_PP)^(-1)R_P V_PQ; (Z_S)_QQ retains V_PQ and V_QP
required_unproved_gates: weighted outgoing Coulomb limiting absorption and Dirichlet resolvent domain
weighted boundary Poisson bounds and the unweighted-volume-pairing dual-transpose trace bound
invertibility or Fredholm/uniqueness for I-R_C^+ V and the P/Q Schur factors
full low-block boundary matching and its Schur inverse
certified constants before any numerical smallness claim
operator_construction.sign_check: with A_S=A_C-V and Z=+partial_r for u=r psi, Green identity gives the displayed plus DtN-difference formula
operator_construction.spaces: H_{+a}=L2(e^{+2a(r-27)}dr dOmega), H_{-a}=L2(e^{-2a(r-27)}dr dOmega), 0<a<1; trace X with W_l=l+1
